name: storydoc
description:
The official Storydoc connector. Browse the templates in your Storydoc account, fill their variables and create a new personalized version, or generate a brand-new deck from scratch with the AI wizard — all in conversation.

Ask for a proposal for a specific client and Claude will find the right template, show you a preview of what it will create, and only build it once you confirm. Every deck lands in your Storydoc account and comes back as a shareable short URL.

You can also ask how your decks are performing: engagement totals, your top stories and versions, and breakdowns by device and location, summarized rather than dumped.

_published_faq.name: How do I add storydoc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add storydoc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.storydoc.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the storydoc MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: storydoc provides these MCP tools: storydoc_create_version, storydoc_generate_story, storydoc_get_analytics, storydoc_get_brand_settings, storydoc_get_story, storydoc_list_stories, storydoc_plan_version, storydoc_resolve_brand, and storydoc_set_brand_settings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to storydoc?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to storydoc in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
storydoc requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
storydoc is developed by Storydoc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
